speaker: Castle
direction: A pragmatic, matriarchal officer who cares for the company and its people. Warm and reassuring while teaching, firm about responsibility. Occasional dry humor, never a permanently dry delivery. Speak to the commander as a capable colleague.
recordingStatus: Script prepared; recordings and audition pending. Text is the complete playable guide.

lines.synthesisText: [warm, conversational voice] Barracks is where we look after our people. Loadout on a squad's card changes its kit; Raise Squad musters a new squad under the selected officer.
[gentle, reassuring voice] Each card shows ready, wounded and vacant places. The wounded keep their billets and are back on duty after a day aboard; the clock at the top says when.

[encouraging, matter-of-fact voice] The wrench fills empty places: on a card for that squad, beside Select All for every selected squad. I draw from reserves first, then enlist Marines from cargo. Hover a wrench to see what it needs.
[warm, confident voice] Check the muster before the next job. Missions takes you back to work; Return leaves the ship. Company Guide opens this walkthrough again.
